svg.title: The eval pyramid: cheap at the bottom, true at the top
svg.desc: A hand-drawn four-band eval pyramid. The widest green base is deterministic assertions - format, length, entities, refusals, no PII - 120 cases in 0.8 seconds for nothing; above it reference matching on 40 cases for nothing; above that an LLM judge on 100 cases for $1.80 and 12 minutes; and at the narrow top human review of 20 cases weekly, the only ground truth. An arrow up the left is labelled cost per case and one down the right is labelled coverage. To the right a statistical-power curve shows the smallest detectable change falling from 24 points at 20 cases through 11 points at 100 - ringed - to 5 points at 500, and a box reading '20 hand-written cases we made up' is struck through beside a loop from a production failure into the pyramid's base.
svg.text: The eval pyramid: cheap at the bottom, true at the top
ASSERTIONS - format, length, entities, refusals, no PII $0.00 /
REFERENCE - exact or fuzzy match to a known-good
cases come from FAILURES, not imagination
the gap is the cases you did not think of.
